svg.title: Training across assemblies: task-level and overall training success

cc:Work.dc:title: Training across assemblies: task-level and overall training success
cc:Work.dc:description: Adapted from paper Figure 5. All 80 displayed heatmap values, four aggregate bars, and nearby-checkpoint standard deviations match the paper. Training reset states and checkpoint sources differ across conditions; see accompanying JSON for provenance, including plotting fallbacks. These are not independent-seed error bars or a matched-total-compute evaluation.
